  * New code_quality finding: getRuntimeDisplayName uses ts-type v8 ignore category (should be source-map) with a factually incorrect coverage claim (both tests pass explicit runtime values, the ?? fallback path is untested).
  * New test_quality findings: pickAgentLabel has only 3/8 branches tested with source-map ignore hiding the gap (pickCompletionAgentType has all 9 tested); prepareComplianceValidationInput has no unit tests despite 4 testable guard-clause paths; mockLogForwarder not reset between tests in metrics.test.ts.
  * CI fully green. All remediation items require code changes (v8 ignore fix + test additions).
